title: First Tick
description: A shipment sitting at the dock isn't "in transit" until dispatch actually says so — the very first advance call is what flips that switch, and it should stick.
successCondition: Book a fresh shipment (status "booked" per the DB default). As dispatcher/admin, call POST /api/tracking/:id/advance once. Querying the shipments table via `npm run db:psql` for that row confirms status now literally stores 'in_transit', not 'booked' — the change is persisted, not just reflected in the response body.
hints: The first call to /advance always transitions booked -> in_transit regardless of position, per docs/api/tracking.md — later calls step position instead.
select status from shipments where id = '<id>'; is the whole check.
